test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

The higher you go, the **cooler it get. **
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence has a subject-verb agreement issue. The subject **"it"** is singular, so the verb must also agree with it in singular form.
 
• The phrase "**the cooler it get**" is incorrect because **"get"** does not agree with the singular subject.
 
• The correct verb form should be "**gets**" to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
• Thus, the correct phrase is "**the cooler it gets**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The higher you go, the cooler it gets."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "cooler it getting"** – This is grammatically incorrect as "getting" cannot replace "gets" in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "more cooler it gets"** – This is incorrect because "cooler" is already a comparative adjective, and adding "more" creates redundancy.
 
• **Option 4: "coolest it becomes"** – This is incorrect because "coolest" is a superlative adjective and is not appropriate in this comparative context.
